summary: Historical analogue constructed in 2026. FRC is used to study correct avoid and terminal failure when funding fragility dominates conventional book-value analysis. No contemporaneous TRQuant recommendation is asserted.
candidate_lessons: When liability flight can outrun asset liquidity, survival analysis dominates valuation analysis.
High uninsured-deposit concentration must be treated as a run-risk state variable, not a static funding statistic.
Book value can become economically irrelevant when forced-sale losses and confidence drive resolution risk.
